I farm this maize plot same way my father showed me. I have small money from last harvest and my sons help me, so I put small fertilizer like neighbors do — one bag of urea share between this plot and another. I keep my own seed from last year, it grow well here. No money for pesticide, and no river close by so rain is what I get.
